notes.title: Our Privacy Policy is correct. There is no "DATA MINING"...
notes.content:
Dear community,

We would like to clarify that all information noted by our Privacy Policy do not violate any law and Steam´s Code of Conduct indeed! 

Please be aware we have never done "data mining" and never taken any advantage of gathering your data. The collecting of some data is a must by which we are ensuring the functionality of our services. The claim about us doing it, is a fraud.

Our Privacy Policy is general and refers to all our games available for all platforms. The collection of any personal or non-personal information applies to the functionality of our products/platforms, that use such a service – namely Dead Effect 1 and Dead Effect 2 for mobiles only. 

Note: We will never collect any information sent outside of the functionality of our Websites/Apps, including through emails or text messages.

This collection is the correct matter of enabling us to:
• provide you with any goods, services or functionality you have requested,
• respond to any inquiries you have made through our customer service features;

In any case, our purpose is not to abuse them!

Dead Effect 1 and Dead Effect 2 to for PC do not use these services, so there is no collecting of information.

Please be aware of the common use of this privacy policy, where is collecting of personal data used in the same way. This formal statement use even greater game developer companies for the same reason as the functionality of our services (etc. https://www.gameloft.com/en/privacy-notice).

Following that we would like to clarify we have never done, did, do or plan to do any “data mining”. As we look into this situation, such a hoax and fraud statement may cause the damage of our good reputation and trustful brand of our game developing. 

So to all loyal members of our great community:

WE ARE NOT DOING ANY DATA MINING 

If any of you suspect such a doing, please promptly contact us at support@badflyinteractive.com. 

All the evidence and information on this case can help us reach the fraud and intervene it through all available legal means.

BFI Team

notes.title: DEAD EFFECT 2 - PC
notes.content:
[img=http://deadeffect2.com/assets/img/landing/DE2_-_Know_your_enemy_02.jpg]

Dear community,

is there anybody in there? I hope there is, because we're still here, very much alive and kicking. We apologize for the long silence, but we've been working on something big and we are now ready to share some exciting news with you:

DEAD EFFECT 2 for PC/MAC is officialy in the works, awww yeeeah!

But that's not all. Are you sitting down? Good, because guess what: it will be Dead Effect 2 with a cooperative multiplayer mode. Right there from the very beginning. How about that?

The Early Access version will be a full-blown game which we will continue to tweak and tune in cooperation with our community to make sure that it will live up to your standards - especially the multiplayer mode.

So, what do you say - are you willing to give it a go?

In the meantime, you can get a taste of what's in stock for you by checking out the mobile release trailers:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K9iNEZou1H0
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hqiPSE5dGq0

notes.title: Face your fear!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

It’s official - if you follow us on Facebook, Twitter or Google+, you might already know… But in case you don’t, here we go: Dead Effect 2 is coming to your mobile devices and PC/MAC this fall!

Check out the trailer [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qYwqef0YHiU]HERE[/url].

Thank you guys for your incredible support you’ve been showing us since Dead Effect 1. We wouldn’t be able to work on the sequel, were it not for you! We’re working really, really hard to deliver the best sci-fi FPS you can imagine. That being said, there is a couple of things we would like to run by you. 

First of all, many of you have been calling for the multiplayer mode since Dead Effect 1 was first published. And we get it – the only thing that is more fun than blowing the heads off hordes of zombies is doing so with your friends (or complete strangers from the dark recesses of the internet, for that matter). We know, right? So yeah. Dead Effect 2 will come with a multiplayer mode. We can’t wait!

Another thing that’s been bugging both you and us is the Linux support for Dead Effect. As much as we would like to accommodate the wishes of the owners of Linux devices and make Dead Effect 1 Linux-compatible, we are currently lacking the manpower and time to do so. We’ve been focusing on Dead Effect 2 for the last couple of months – that’s a lot of stuff to deal with, people. Stay tuned then! We hope that you’ll all enjoy Dead Effect 2. Here’s a couple of cool screenshots to brighten your day :-)


[img]http://deadeffect2.com/assets/img/landing/DE2_screen_01.jpg[/img]

[img]http://deadeffect2.com/assets/img/landing/DE2_screen_02.jpg[/img]

[img]http://deadeffect2.com/assets/img/landing/DE2_drone.jpg[/img]

[img]http://deadeffect2.com/assets/img/landing/DE2_cyborg.jpg[/img]

notes.title: HELLO THERE!
notes.content:
A couple of weeks have passed since the release of our game, during of which we've seen tons of positive reactions and complimentary reviews. It's like watching our kid go off to college and see him getting straight A's! We are very proud of it, but even prouder of you. We've been very lucky to have such a loyal, enthusiastic community. Thank you for everything you're doing for us!

We are well aware of the fact that our game is far from perfect. However, we constantly monitor all the feedback and we use your tips and suggestions not only to improve Dead Effect 1, but also to give us an idea of what to steer clear from in our future projects. Your help is invaluable - our mission is to create games that you, our audience, will enjoy. 

We are not an AAA studio and all you can see is the work of a very small team of very dedicated people. This is something that some of the less favourable reviews forget about - we do not have the backing of a large sponsor or lots of staff, and all this has taken lots of blood (literally), toil, tears, and sweat. Still, being compared to AAA titles is something we have never even dreamed of, and it's a great boost of confidence to us. We promise to keep up the good work, and we hope we can enlist your help in the future as well.

Thank you, you're the best!

Sincerely,
BadFly team

notes.title: Dead Effect is Gold now!
notes.content:
Ladies and Gentlemen, we’re proud to announce that Dead Effect PC/MAC is finally completed. Thanks to the success of the Early Access version, our game is ready. 

Successful Early Access !!

We’d like to thank Valve for giving us the opportunity to release Early Access on Steam. This feature helped us immensely and without it, we wouldn’t be able to finish the game. During the Early Access stage, we had the chance to work on Dead Effect and finish the game in its entirety. We were also able to give it a much higher quality than we’ve originally expected. Thanks to the support and resources we’ve gained in the Early Acess stage, we had the chance to add many new core features for the PC/MAC version of Dead Effect (for example new enemies and visual enhancements). We were also able to add many improvements and innovations that the fan community asked for. 

We also want to express our deepest thanks to the whole community. Your comments, reports and observations have helped us to fine-tune the game to its final shape. We could not have done it without you. Thank you!

BadFly Dev Team
Shissa

notes.title: Beta Update 1.4 (Is Live!)
notes.content:
Dear DE community,

Before the final release of Dead Effect, we have one more update to share with you. It will bring some more changes and improvements which many of you asked for.

One of the most important things this update fixes is the technical glitch that caused many of you to get a black screen. We’ve looked into it and found that the problem was in the Unity engine. Unity version 4.5.4 has fixed the problem and so DE should be fine as well.

You can find more info from Unity here – http://unity3d.com/unity/whats-new/unity-4.5.4  - “Fixed full screen rendering at less than native resolution.”

After a long debate among our team’s members, we’ve also decided to change the graphical interface and the design of the main menu so you’ll be able to interact with it more easily and also use the controller. The change was a lot more complicated than it may seem at first glance. We had to go all the way down to the core mechanics of the game and change things there, so the implementation has taken us quite a long time.

We’ve implemented German into the game and we’re still working on the small bugs that came with it. We’re also preparing a French version of DE.

Currency has been rebalanced in later parts of the game.

We’ve prepared a little Christmas surprise for you as well and added a small sandbox testing level for you all to play around in. It’s the level the team uses for testing and though it’s simple, we hope that many of you will have lots of fun with it.

We’re still working on the multiplayer part of the game, so you don’t have to worry, we haven’t forgotten about it. It’s simply a process that takes a long time because we need to add features we haven’t counted on when we were creating the core build of the game. Changing everything so that it allows for multiplayer is very time consuming, but we won’t abandon the idea. You can expect to see it in one of the future updates.

BadFly Dev Team

notes.title: Dead Effect - Beta Update 1.3 (Is Live!)
notes.content:
[img]http://deadeffect.com/!de/presentation/Dead_Effect_Hybrid_beta.jpg[/img]

Hello, Dead Effect Community!

After a period of silence, we’re happy to let you know that we’ve almost finished work on the promised update for Dead Effect, which will definitely push the game into Beta! We’re still squashing some bugs, but the update will come out soon.

Before that happens though, we’d like to give you a list of things you can look forward to:

• Added 6 new missions to the single player campaign. It’s now entirely finished. 
• Added 2 new survival arenas.
• Added the ability to sprint and dodge enemy attacks (to the right, to the left or backwards). These features will use a new player resource – stamina. Stamina will determine how long you can sprint and how many times you can dodge an attack before getting tired. Stamina will regenerate on its own over time.
• Added a new player ability – Devastation. It will enable you to use a strong area of effect attack, which will destroy everything in a 7 meter radius around your character. We believe that it will help you create better survival tactics, especially when you’re up against a large number of enemies.
• Added new ammo for the bow – Electrical Arrows. They cause more damage than the regular ones, so you’ll have a fighting chance against large groups of zombies.
• Added a new weapon – Deviant ARC
• Added a new type of enemy – the Cannibal. A deadly foe that’s faster and a lot more aggressive than other zombies.
• Added the ability to shoot off enemies’ arms and legs.
• Added new achievements.
• Added a few new cutscenes.

We have also fixed a few things that were causing problems:
• Improved the graphics on low settings. Things shouldn’t be as dark anymore.
• Added new graphical options – resolution, gamma, vertical sync, etc.
• Added new mouse options – acceleration, smoothing, etc.
• Added new FOV options.
• Weapons have been rebalanced according to the suggestions on Steam.
• From now on, when you aim, you will see a red dot indicating where you’re shooting.
• Added an indicator of the number of zombies you’ve killed and the number of credits/gold you’ve collected in the level.
• You can now view the tablets you have previously picked up in the main menu.
• Alt + TAB should no longer cause the game’s graphics to glitch.
• The environment should now react to damage – dents, bullet holes, blackened walls after explosions.

We have also implemented various language versions of the game, such as Russian, Spanish, Hungarian, Czech and Slovak. We are also planning to add German and French in future updates. Some parts of the game are still being translated, however, so you may encounter pieces of English text here and there, as well as other technical problems. We have to ask for your patience until we receive the feedback necessary to fix possible issues. We would also like to ask you all to keep in mind that these translations are fan-made and mistakes may appear.

BadFly team

• Added new ammo for the bow – Electrical Arrows. They cause more damage than the regular ones, so you’ll have a fighting chance against large groups of zombies.
• Added a new weapon – Deviant ARC
• Added a new type of enemy – the Cannibal. A deadly foe that’s faster and a lot more aggressive than other zombies.
• Added the ability to shoot off enemies’ arms and legs.
• Added new achievements.
• Added a few new cutscenes.

We have also fixed a few things that were causing problems:
• Improved the graphics on low settings. Things shouldn’t be as dark anymore.
• Added new graphical options – resolution, gamma, vertical sync, etc.
• Added new mouse options – acceleration, smoothing, etc.
• Added new FOV options.
• Weapons have been rebalanced according to the suggestions on Steam.
• From now on, when you aim, you will see a red dot indicating where you’re shooting.
• Added an indicator of the number of zombies you’ve killed and the number of credits/gold you’ve collected in the level.
• You can now view the tablets you have previously picked up in the main menu.
• Alt + TAB should no longer cause the game’s graphics to glitch.
• The environment should now react to damage – dents, bullet holes, blackened walls after explosions.

We have also implemented various language versions of the game, such as Russian, Spanish, Hungarian, Czech and Slovak. We are also planning to add German and French in future updates. Some parts of the game are still being translated, however, so you may encounter pieces of English text here and there, as well as other technical problems. We have to ask for your patience until we receive the feedback necessary to fix possible issues. We would also like to ask you all to keep in mind that these translations are fan-made and mistakes may appear.

BadFly team

BadFly Dev Team.
Shissa

notes.title: Future Updates!
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

after a period of silence, we're back with news about the game.

The team is working hard on finishing and improving the game. We're closely watching all of your feedback on this forum and we're trying to solve the issues you're reporting to make the game the best it can be.

Currently, it is our goal to finish the entire game with all of its features within two months (if everything goes as it ideally should).  The game could then be released at the beginning of November as the Beta version. It should have the Single Player Campaign including all the weapons and enemies, achievements and other features such as the Survival Mode and Biohazard Arenas.

Sadly, not all of the features you'd like to see can be implemented into the game. This is because the game's technology doesn't allow us to do so, since we didn't count with such features when we were originally creating the game. Trying to add them would mean changing its core techonology, which would set us back and add a lot of work.

If the game is finished and we are entirely happy with it, we would like to publish it before Christmas of this year.

All the best from 

Dev. Team
Shissa

notes.title: Update 1.03 is Live!
notes.content:
HELLO STEAM COMMUNITY!

Update 1.03 is here, bringing you a few new improvements. 

Even though the update has been postponed a few times, it’s finally here now and it brings a lot of new content, which you can enjoy.

We would like to apologize for the delay. As the game keeps getting larger and larger, there’s a lot more to fix and improve and it takes us longer to get everything to work properly.

We’d like to thank everyone for their continued support, it means a lot to us. 


And now, let’s look at the new content you’ll find in Update 1.03.

• 3 new singleplayer missions (Data Fields, Cargo Bay, Propulsion Shaft)
• 3 new weapons (Hydra – shotgun, Turn – assult rifle, Equinox – crossbow)
• a new model for the Aasault Turret
• a new puzzle/hacking mini game
• a new character augmentation system (you can improve your character)
• a new kind enemy – Exploding Zombie
• a pack of achievements to accompany the new singleplayer missions
• new control options (keys 1, 2, 3, 4 are the new hotkeys for weapons, it‘s also possible to toggle aim and crouch)
• improved crouch (camera and weapon accuracy)
• revolver reload new animation
• and many many many more other features

We hope you’ll enjoy the update,

Your Dev Team

notes.title: Update 1.01 is Live!
notes.content:
We’d like to thank everyone for all your support and your feedback. Here’s a list of bugfixes in Update 1.01.

General
• Added new Survive and Biohazard level "ISOLATION"
• Added a checkpoint system
• The tutorial hints explaining the game's controls and basic mechanics have been improved
• Mods and levels should no longer remain locked after the player has finished the game
• The indicator of the flashlight's remaining battery has been added
• Returning from the pause menu should no longer cause the equipped weapon to fire
• The player should be able to replenish ammo after every round in Biohazard mode
• Autoheal's healing efficiency has been adjusted and it should no longer make the game seem too easy
• Improved HUD blood effects

Animation
• Added some more animations for all normal zombies
• Improved animations

Weapons
• Added a new weapon, the Chainsaw
• Grenades should no longer be automatically thrown when scrolling through weapons using the mouse wheel. The player will now need to equip the grenade by scrolling to it and then use the fire button to throw it. The distance of the throw will depend on how long the player holds down the fire button
• Fixed the bug that made the pistol appear empty even after it has been reloaded and the slide is locked back after reload
• Reloading is now a little bit faster

Graphics
• Improved the lighting on low graphical settings

Options (sounds, controls)
• Added the possible to bind keys, mouse and controller
• Better gamepad support - the gamepad should now aim properly
• Added the option to toggle mouse acceleration on/off and a wider sensitivity range
• Added the ability to map all the mouse buttons
• Audio options have been added to the main menu (music, sfx)

Achievements
• Players should get certain achievements in Survival and Bioharazd modes from now on

We've also added and improved many other small things.

As a side note we'd like to mention that we're preparing a lot of new content for you. It will be added in the next update (1.02) that should be out within the next couple of weeks along with other bugfixes which we didn't fix in the current update.

Please keep sending us your feedback, it's helped us greatly thus far.
